final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrower framing is more accurate than the original clean compliance claim, but it still does not satisfy the policy condition needed for a compliance finding. On the available record, the segment miss is tied to a named launch use case, legal review is still open, and there is no evidence of either resolution or approved risk acceptance. That means the caveat is not just explanatory; it marks an unresolved compliance predicate. A caveated description of the dispute may make the certification posture more defensible operationally, but it is not enough to upgrade the audit result to compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the disclosure issue was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance for the named segment gap.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open on the present record.
The policy text treats a weakness affecting a named launch use case as material, and the developer-support migration segment is described as named in a partner launch checklist.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents support release readiness but do not satisfy the unresolved disclosure predicate.
